ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit recovery-destruction salvo (vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + bcdedit + wbadmin chain)
ucs.description: Hunts the multi-utility shadow-copy and boot-recovery destruction chain LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/5.0 fires from a single cmd.exe wrapper immediately before encryption. The exact token combination (bcdedit bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures + recoveryenabled No + wbadmin delete catalog + wmic shadowcopy delete) is a hard-coded LockBit fingerprint embedded in the encryptor binary (CISA AA23-165A).
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe") by Processes.dest Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval c=lower(process) | eval s_vss=if(match(c,"vssadmin.*delete.*shadows"),1,0), s_wmic=if(match(c,"wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete"),1,0), s_boot=if(match(c,"bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy.*ignoreallfailures"),1,0), s_recov=if(match(c,"bcdedit.*recoveryenabled.*no"),1,0), s_wbadmin=if(match(c,"wbadmin.*delete.*catalog"),1,0) | eval salvo=s_vss+s_wmic+s_boot+s_recov+s_wbadmin | where salvo>=2 | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user parent_process_name process_name process salvo
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName in~ ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","wmic.exe","vssadmin.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe")
| extend Cmd = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| extend SalvoHits =
      iff(Cmd has "vssadmin" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "shadows", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "wmic" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "bcdedit" and Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy" and Cmd has "ignoreallfailures", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "bcdedit" and Cmd has "recoveryenabled" and Cmd has "no", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "wbadmin" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "catalog", 1, 0)
| where SalvoHits >= 2  // >=2 hard-coded LockBit destruction tokens on the same cmd line
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, SalvoHits
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| extend Cmd = tolower(CommandLine)
| extend SalvoHits =
      iff(Cmd has "vssadmin" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "shadows", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "wmic" and Cmd has "shadowcopy" and Cmd has "delete", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "bcdedit" and Cmd has "bootstatuspolicy" and Cmd has "ignoreallfailures", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "bcdedit" and Cmd has "recoveryenabled" and Cmd has "no", 1, 0)
    + iff(Cmd has "wbadmin" and Cmd has "delete" and Cmd has "catalog", 1, 0)
| where SalvoHits >= 2  // canonical LockBit recovery-destruction chain
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, ParentProcessName, CommandLine, SalvoHits
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit Recovery Destruction Salvo
id: 8a5d4f12-3c01-4d9e-9b6f-9c0ab8d72e10
status: experimental
description: Detects the multi-utility recovery destruction chain (vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + bcdedit bootstatuspolicy/recoveryenabled + wbadmin delete catalog) hard-coded in LockBit 2.0/3.0/Black/5.0 encryptor binaries (CISA AA23-165A).
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa23-165a
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-040a
tags:
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.t1489
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  vssadmin:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'vssadmin'
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  wmic_shadow:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'wmic'
      - 'shadowcopy'
      - 'delete'
  bcdedit_boot:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'bcdedit'
      - 'bootstatuspolicy'
      - 'ignoreallfailures'
  bcdedit_recov:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'bcdedit'
      - 'recoveryenabled'
      - 'no'
  wbadmin_catalog:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'wbadmin'
      - 'delete'
      - 'catalog'
  condition: 2 of (vssadmin, wmic_shadow, bcdedit_boot, bcdedit_recov, wbadmin_catalog)
falsepositives:
  - Backup software performing scheduled retention cleanup (will hit at most one token)
  - Administrator manually disabling recovery during planned maintenance
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.security @EventID:4688 ((@CommandLine:*vssadmin* AND @CommandLine:*bcdedit*) OR (@CommandLine:*bcdedit* AND @CommandLine:*wbadmin*) OR (@CommandLine:*vssadmin* AND @CommandLine:*wbadmin*) OR (@CommandLine:*shadowcopy* AND @CommandLine:*bcdedit*) OR (@CommandLine:*bootstatuspolicy* AND @CommandLine:*ignoreallfailures*) OR (@CommandLine:*recoveryenabled* AND @CommandLine:*wbadmin*))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(cmd|powershell|pwsh|wmic|vssadmin|wbadmin|bcdedit)\.exe$/i
| regex("(?i)(vssadmin.*delete.*shadows|wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete|bcdedit.*bootstatuspolicy.*ignoreallfailures|bcdedit.*recoveryenabled.*no|wbadmin.*delete.*catalog)", field=CommandLine)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName], function=[count(as=salvoEvents), collect([ImageFileName, CommandLine])])
| salvoEvents >= 2
ucs.rationale: Other ransomware families (Conti, BlackCat) delete shadow copies, but the LockBit family's encryptor uniquely chains FIVE specific recovery-destruction primitives in a single cmd.exe /c wrapper - vssadmin + wmic shadowcopy + bcdedit bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures + bcdedit recoveryenabled No + wbadmin delete catalog. CISA AA23-165A reverse-engineered this exact salvo from LockBit 3.0 (Black) a

ucs.title: [LLM] LockBit 2.0 GPO-based self-propagation via SYSVOL startup-script payload write
ucs.description: Detects the LockBit 2.0/3.0 tradecraft of pushing the encryptor domain-wide by writing executables/scripts into a Domain Controller's SYSVOL Group Policy Startup-Script or Scheduled-Tasks directories from an interactive (non-machine) account. CISA AA22-040A and Sophos document this as the LockBit-specific self-propagation step that distinguishes it from PsExec-only ransomware families.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Filesystem.file_path) as file_path values(Filesystem.file_hash) as file_hash values(Filesystem.process_name) as process_name values(Filesystem.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_path="*\\SYSVOL\\*" AND (Filesystem.file_path="*\\Machine\\Scripts\\Startup*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Machine\\Preferences\\ScheduledTasks*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*\\Machine\\Preferences\\Files*") AND (Filesystem.file_name="*.exe" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.dll" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.bat" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.ps1" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.cmd" OR Filesystem.file_name="*.vbs" OR Filesystem.file_name="ScheduledTasks.xml") AND Filesystem.action="created" by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.file_name Filesystem.file_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | where NOT match(user,"\$$") AND NOT match(user,"(?i)^(system|local service|network service)$") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | table firstTime lastTime dest user process_name file_name file_path file_hash
ucs.kql:
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FolderPath has @"\SYSVOL\"
| where FolderPath has_any (@"\Machine\Scripts\Startup", @"\Machine\Preferences\ScheduledTasks", @"\Machine\Preferences\Files")
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileRenamed","FileModified")
| where FileName endswith ".exe" or FileName endswith ".dll" or FileName endswith ".bat"
     or FileName endswith ".ps1" or FileName endswith ".cmd" or FileName endswith ".vbs"
     or FileName =~ "ScheduledTasks.xml"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend GpoGuid = extract(@"Policies\\\{([0-9A-Fa-f\-]+)\}", 1, FolderPath)
| summarize WriteCount = count(), FirstWrite = min(Timestamp), LastWrite = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctFiles = make_set(FileName, 25), Hashes = make_set(SHA256, 25),
            GpoGuids = make_set(GpoGuid, 10), Spawners = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName, 10)
        by DCName = DeviceName, Actor = InitiatingProcessAccountName,
           ActorDomain = InitiatingProcessAccountDomain
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventType == "FileCreated"
| where TargetFilePath has @"\SYSVOL\"
| where TargetFilePath has_any (@"\Machine\Scripts\Startup", @"\Machine\Preferences\ScheduledTasks", @"\Machine\Preferences\Files")
| where TargetFileExtension in~ ("exe","dll","bat","ps1","cmd","vbs","xml")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where ActorUsername !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| extend GpoGuid = extract(@"Policies\\\{([0-9A-Fa-f\-]+)\}", 1, TargetFilePath)
| summarize WriteCount = count(), FirstWrite = min(TimeGenerated), LastWrite = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctFiles = make_set(TargetFileName, 25), Hashes = make_set(TargetFileSHA256, 25),
            GpoGuids = make_set(GpoGuid, 10), Spawners = make_set(ActingProcessName, 10)
        by DCName = DvcHostname, Actor = ActorUsername
| order by FirstWrite desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: LockBit GPO-Based Ransomware Deployment via SYSVOL Startup Script Write
id: 4e2b7a91-9b3c-4a3e-8d10-7d44d2a5f0e3
status: experimental
description: Detects interactive-user writes of executables, scripts, or Scheduled-Tasks GPP XML into the SYSVOL Group Policy Machine\Scripts\Startup or Preferences\ScheduledTasks directories - LockBit 2.0/3.0 self-propagation tradecraft documented by CISA AA22-040A and Sophos.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa22-040a
  - https://news.sophos.com/en-us/2022/04/12/lockbit-ransomware-deployed-via-group-policy-objects/
tags:
  - attack.defense-evasion
  - attack.lateral-movement
  - attack.impact
  - attack.t1484.001
  - attack.t1037.001
  - attack.t1486
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  sysvol_path:
    TargetFilename|contains: '\SYSVOL\'
  policy_payload_dir:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '\Machine\Scripts\Startup\'
      - '\Machine\Preferences\ScheduledTasks\'
      - '\Machine\Preferences\Files\'
  payload_ext:
    TargetFilename|endswith:
      - '.exe'
      - '.dll'
      - '.bat'
      - '.cmd'
      - '.ps1'
      - '.vbs'
  scheduled_tasks_xml:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\ScheduledTasks.xml'
  filter_machine_account:
    User|endswith: '$'
  filter_system:
    User:
      - 'SYSTEM'
      - 'LOCAL SERVICE'
      - 'NETWORK SERVICE'
  condition: sysvol_path and policy_payload_dir and (payload_ext or scheduled_tasks_xml) and not 1 of filter_*
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate GPO authoring by domain admins during onboarding or scheduled software deployment
  - Patch-management products that publish startup scripts via GPO
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:11 (@TargetFilename:*\\SYSVOL\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\sysvol\\*) (@TargetFilename:*\\Machine\\Scripts\\Startup\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\Machine\\Preferences\\ScheduledTasks\\* OR @TargetFilename:*\\Machine\\Preferences\\Files\\*) (@TargetFilename:*.exe OR @TargetFilename:*.EXE OR @TargetFilename:*.dll OR @TargetFilename:*.bat OR @TargetFilename:*.ps1 OR @TargetFilename:*.PS1 OR @TargetFilename:*.cmd OR @TargetFilename:*.vbs OR @TargetFilename:*ScheduledTasks.xml) -@User:*$
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=FileWritten
| TargetFileName=/\\SYSVOL\\.*\\Machine\\(Scripts\\Startup|Preferences\\ScheduledTasks|Preferences\\Files)\\.*\.(exe|dll|bat|ps1|cmd|vbs|xml)$/i
| NOT UserName=/\$$/
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ContextImageFileName], function=[count(as=writes), collect([TargetFileName])])
| writes >= 1
ucs.rationale: Most ransomware families lateralise via PsExec, WMI, or hands-on-keyboard - LockBit 2.0/3.0 is distinguished by abusing the domain controller's own Group Policy mechanism to push the encryptor to every joined host in a single operation, then triggering gpupdate /force. CISA AA22-040A and Sophos's April 2022 teardown both document this exact pattern: the affiliate authenticates as a privileged user
